  "source": [
    "FUNCTION S_CUS_IMG_ACTIVITY_GET_OBJECTS.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IMG_ACTIVITY) TYPE  CUS_IMG_AC OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(RETURN_ALL_ACTIVITIES) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      IMG_ACTIVITIES STRUCTURE  CUS_IMGACH OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      OBJECTS STRUCTURE  CUS_ACTOBJ OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      ACTIVITY_OBJECT_RELATION STRUCTURE  CUS_IFACE2 OPTIONAL",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*",
    "  if RETURN_ALL_ACTIVITIES eq true.",
    "    if objects is requested.",
    "      select a~ACT_ID",
    "             a~OBJECTTYPE",
    "             a~OBJECTNAME",
    "             a~TCODE",
    "             a~SUBOBJNAME",
    "             a~VARIANT",
    "             a~TXN_NO_CON",
    "             a~IMG_POS",
    "             into table objects",
    "             from cus_actobj as a",
    "             join cus_imgach as b",
    "               on    a~act_id   = b~c_activity.",
    "    endif.",
    "    if ACTIVITY_OBJECT_RELATION is requested.",
    "      select b~activity",
    "           a~ACT_ID",
    "           a~OBJECTTYPE",
    "           a~OBJECTNAME",
    "           a~TCODE",
    "           a~SUBOBJNAME",
    "           a~VARIANT",
    "           a~TXN_NO_CON",
    "           a~IMG_POS",
    "           into table ACTIVITY_OBJECT_RELATION",
    "           from cus_actobj as a",
    "           join cus_imgach as b",
    "             on    a~act_id   = b~c_activity.",
    "    endif.",
    "  else.",
    "    if img_activity ne space.",
    "      img_activities-activity = img_activity.",
    "      append img_activities.",
    "    endif.",
    "    describe table img_activities lines table_lines.",
    "    if table_lines eq 0.",
    "      exit.",
    "    endif.",
    "*",
    "    if objects is requested.",
    "      select a~ACT_ID",
    "             a~OBJECTTYPE",
    "             a~OBJECTNAME",
    "             a~TCODE",
    "             a~SUBOBJNAME",
    "             a~VARIANT",
    "             a~TXN_NO_CON",
    "             a~IMG_POS",
    "             into table objects",
    "             from cus_actobj as a",
    "             join cus_imgach as b",
    "               on    a~act_id   = b~c_activity",
    "               for all entries in img_activities",
    "               where b~activity = img_activities-activity.",
    "    endif.",
    "    if ACTIVITY_OBJECT_RELATION is requested.",
    "      select   b~activity",
    "               a~ACT_ID",
    "               a~OBJECTTYPE",
    "               a~OBJECTNAME",
    "               a~TCODE",
    "               a~SUBOBJNAME",
    "               a~VARIANT",
    "               a~TXN_NO_CON",
    "               a~IMG_POS",
    "               into table ACTIVITY_OBJECT_RELATION",
    "               from cus_actobj as a",
    "               join cus_imgach as b",
    "                 on    a~act_id   = b~c_activity",
    "                 for all entries in img_activities",
    "                 where b~activity = img_activities-activity.",
    "    endif.",
    "  endif.",
    "*",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
